event.distribution_pattern: One distributer located in Virginia as well as their dairy store in Maryland .

products.product_quantity: 106, 18 lb buckets and 36, 40 lb buckets were made and distributed
products.reason_for_recall: The firm had a deviation from the Standard of Procedure in the manufacture of Clover Hill Dairy, Soft Ricotta. The facility was temporarily storing whey in a raw milk silo, without cleaning and sanitizing the silo after raw milk use. The firm recalled the Clover Hill Dairy, Soft Ricotta.
